title: finding(app-shell): the Studio flow screen preview drops a screen field's `options`, `placeholder` and `defaultValue` — a `select` renders as a text box — though its header promises "exactly as the end user will see it at runtime"
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a named producer. objectstack `examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts` (at objectstack `0f6dcac5e9`, the `@objectstack/*` 17.5.0 tag), screen node `screen_1`, has two fields:
- `priority`: `type: 'select'` with `options` and `defaultValue: 'normal'`;
- `category`: `type: 'select'` with `options`.

**Measured once**, by the objectui#9248 dev in a one-shot probe on the real `ScreenPreview` versus the runtime `ScreenView`, with a select field carrying `options` and a text field carrying a `placeholder`:
- preview: `combobox 0 | textbox 1 | placeholder 0`;
- runtime: `combobox 1 | textbox 0 | placeholder 1`.

`ScreenPreview`'s own header says the screen is "rendered exactly as the end user will see it at runtime". **Confirmed at source and escalated** by PR objectui#11188's contract review (`5907855070`, ③), which found the named producer.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11188 (objectui#9248), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (`5907589570`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (objectui `origin/main` `37d166280`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/screen-spec.ts` `toScreenFields` (`:269`) projects each field down to `name`, `label`, `type`, `required` and `visibleWhen`. PR objectui#11188 adds `min` / `max` / `inlineHelpText` / `reference`, carried under the claim amendment `5907646725`. So `options`, `placeholder` and `defaultValue` never reach `ScreenView`, although `ScreenView` renders all three at runtime.

The gap predates PR objectui#11188: its byte-identical key-less control covers the base.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- `toScreenFields` carries every `ScreenFieldSpec` key that `ScreenView` renders, so the preview and the runtime cannot differ by projection. ⛔ No second hand-kept key list: derive it from what the renderer reads, or pin the two together.
- **`defaultValue` is not mechanical.** It carries the engine's suspend-time token interpolation (`{…}` templates). The preview either applies the same interpolation the Debug run does, or shows the literal with a marker. Pick one and state it.
- **Pins:**
  - `app-todo`'s `screen_1` shape renders two comboboxes in the preview, as it does at runtime;
  - a `placeholder` shows;
  - a key-less field renders as today (the control).

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (down to #8130) were grepped:
- `ScreenPreview`, `toScreenFields`, `buildScreenSpec`, `screen preview`: 12 hits, all closed. They cover the locale and `visibleWhen` gating (objectui#10693, PR objectui#10763, PR objectui#10736, PR objectui#10857 and neighbours). None covers the projection dropping these keys.
